listings.desc: 50 acres ready to hunt with numerous food plots and maintained trails. 42x60 pole building with new concrete floor and electric. Strong timber value in white oak and walnut. Ideal homesite overlooking a wildlife food plot. Trophy bucks captured on trail cameras.
213-acre wooded tract near Dahinda. Large contiguous timber block with rolling terrain and strong timber value.
